The False Politics of Western Declinism

Sep 10, 2026

Carl Johan Dalgaard
 and Mark Medish

Political leaders on both sides of the Atlantic increasingly portray the West as being in decline, even as their societies grow richer. By conflating a loss of relative economic power with falling living standards, they give populists an opening to turn domestic grievances into nationalist resentment.

COPENHAGEN/LONDON—As President Donald Trump plunges the United States into another reckless trade war—this time with neighboring Canada, one of its largest trading partners, and a NATO ally—the irony is hard to miss. Despite being the main architect and beneficiary of the multilateral trading system since 1945, the US under Trump has recast itself—at least rhetorically—as the victim of an allegedly unfair economic order.
